provenance.note: QUOTE PROVENANCE CORRECTION 2026-10-18: the previously stored quote ('Attribution of authorship carries with it accountability for the work, and AI tools cannot take such responsibility.', labelled 'Instructions for authors') does not appear verbatim on the coded URL (Wayback 2026-08-27) nor on JAMA's Instructions for Authors (Wayback 2026-09-16). Replaced with verbatim text from the coded URL. The Instructions for Authors carry the operative rule verbatim: 'Nonhuman artificial intelligence, language models, machine learning, or similar technologies do not qualify for authorship. If these models or tools are used to create content or assist with writing or manuscript preparation, authors must take responsibility for the integrity of the content generated'. The coded page adds a submission-system disclosure question and 'In all such cases, authors must take responsibility for the integrity of the content generated by these models and tools.' Scores unmoved; the substance supports D2=2 and D3=2 as coded.
